as_told.title: Pasulka's Heaven Can Wait finds abduction-like accounts in Catholic sources

plain: While researching Heaven Can Wait, her 2014 book on Purgatory, a religious studies professor named Diana Pasulka of the University of North Carolina Wilmington began documenting dozens of historical cases of nuns, priests, brothers and saints, Francis of Assisi among them, who reported direct contact with God or angels. Michels tells this himself, describing some of those accounts as resembling modern alien abduction stories, which would tie religious visions to UFO experience.
